question: The phenomenon of 'dispersion of light' into its seven constituent colours was discovered by ________ in 1666.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Isaac Newton**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dispersion of light**:

 
 
• The **splitting of white light**, when **it passes through **a **glass prism **into its **constituent spectrum **is known as the **dispersion of light**.
 
 
 
• **White light consists **of **seven colors **and **Isaac Newton **passed the **white light through a prism **and **got seven different colors**.
 
• Sunlight splits into **7 colors **– Violet, Indigo, Blue, Green, Yellow, Orange, and Red (VIBGYOR).
 
• A **rainbow **is a **natural phenomenon showing the dispersion of light**.

 [IMAGE: https://www.cyberphysics.co.uk/MobileVersion/graphics/diagrams/light/prism_dispersion.jpg] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sir **Isaac Newton **was an **English mathematician**, **physicist**, **astronomer**, **alchemist**, **theologian**, and **author**, **widely recognised **as one of the **greatest mathematicians **and **physicists **of **all time **and **among **the **most influential scientists**.
 
• **Isaac Newton **is **best known **for his **theory **about the **law of gravity**, but **his “Principia Mathematica” (1686) **with its **three laws of motion greatly **influenced the **Enlightenment in Europe.**
